newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks close mixed, blue chips active.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks close mixed, blue chips active.

text.p: Croatian stocks closed mixed to lower on Wednesday with blue chips trading on solid volumes.
* Of 19 traded issues four rose, eight fell and six were flat and one traded for the first time
* Volume lower at 24,753 units, turnover fell to 13 million kuna.
* Top gainer Zagrebacka Banka added 29.9 kuna or 1.5 percent to 2,000 kuna, selling 2,768 shares.
* Biggest decliner shipper Jadroplov lost 15 kuna or 10.3 percent to 130 with 86 shares sold.

* Cement factory Nasicecement, stable at 445 kuna, sold most shares -- 9,700, but in a single transaction. It was followed by food processor Podravka, which closed flat at 250 kuna on volume of 3,846 units.
